title: Sariema sound description
description: A game's sounds, buses, mixes and loudness checks; the file sariema.json's audio key points to. `sariema audio build` turns it into a sound bank (.srms).

root.description: Directory the sound files are relative to, from the project directory. Default: the project directory.

buses.description: The mixer's buses, in order. Default: music −24 LUFS, voice −21, effects −24, ambience −30, all at 0 dB gain.

target_lufs.description: Integrated loudness every sound of the bus is brought to before its own gain_db. Null or absent plays sounds at the level they were measured.

sounds.description: Sound name to its file and how it plays.

stream.description: Decode while playing instead of at load: for music and long ambience.

on_demand.description: Decode only on an explicit preload, release on unload: for voice lines.

loop.description: true loops the whole sound; an object loops [start, end) in frames of the decoded sound at its own sample rate.

enter_s.description: Fade when this sound becomes the music.

leave_s.description: Fade when this sound stops being the music.

mixes.description: Mix name to the sounds that play together; the loudness checks compare them with the music of the same mix.

over_music_db.description: Bus name to how far, in dB, its sounds may play over the loudest music of a mix. Default ambience 0, effects 9.

seam_step_db.description: Largest level step at a loop seam. Default 6.

seam_window_s.description: Seconds compared on each side of a seam. Default 0.2.
